ACCEPT — PR #7844 (services seat review, session `session_01JVfWSQN9RDDGwdVSmMc29x`).

What shipped: the **enforce** branch of ADR-0049, with the deciding evidence I endorse — `UploadProgressSchema.status` already publishes `failed`/`expired` to every API client, so removal would have forked the object enum from the spec contract (and hit the dispatch's own spec-STOP condition), while both statuses name real, previously-invisible failure states. `expired`: chunk PUT / complete against a session past its own `expires_at` now refuse **410 `UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED`** and stamp the row; progress REPORTS the status (the SDK polls it first). `failed`: a completion whose backend throws stamps the row instead of stranding it at non-terminal `completing` (which the 7d retention never reaped). Retry semantics preserved — `failed` records an attempt, doesn't lock the session.

Review notes:
- Deliberate non-behaviours pinned by tests are exactly the right guardrails: no invented deadlines (no `expires_at` ⇒ never expired), `completed` rows immune to the reaper clock, expiry checked AFTER the resume-token gate (no state disclosure to non-owners), best-effort-but-loud `failed` stamp that never eats the real backend cause.
- 8 new tests all assert the DURABLE row via `store.getSession`; error-envelope conformance case added for the new 410.
- ⚠️ Declared-surface addition, accepted with declaration: one additive line in `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` registering `UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED` — forced by the closed `ErrorCode` union (ADR-0112); the alternative (reusing a semantically wrong code) is the bypass the ledger's own header forbids. Cross-seat declaration to the spec seat follows. The checklist item revision (rev 3) closes the clause-5 finding that this card owned — proper rider.
- #5536 ride-along: correctly not triggered (diff avoids `storage-service-plugin.ts`).
- Patch round (1): the spec ledger line regenerates `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` and the generated set wasn't committed — `check:docs` red in the TS job. Fixed via the regen discipline (#5370/#5371 traps avoided); all 26 checks green on the patched head. 产物随源走 lesson recorded for the seat: any spec source touch ⇒ name the regen step in the dispatch.
- Worktree note in the report (real detached worktree after the guard hook fired, no `OS_ALLOW_MAIN_EDITS`, no stash) — compliant path, worth the read for other cloud devs.
- Open questions endorsed as filed: the `packages/client` `resumeUpload` short-circuit on `status === 'expired'` is a legitimate follow-up for the `domain:cli` seat (will flag in the round report); the presigned-family deadline asymmetry is a recorded choice.

Marking ready and arming auto-merge now.
